name: Bombay Metrics Supply Chain Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, Bombay Metrics Supply Chain Ltd does trading of engineering tools and components and supply chain management services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a full-service provider of global manufacturing, engineering and supply chain management services. It is an official resale partner of MESH in the Asia Pacific Region. MESH is an all-in-one solution for global sourcing, procurement, supplier, and quality project management for manufacturers

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 25.4%
